description.en: Planned fossil-form study featuring tall tight helicoid shell with rows of rounded nodes on descending whorls.
description.zh: 拟议化石形态研究：高紧螺塔壳，各下降壳圈带圆瘤列。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level fossil-form planning study, informed by named reference material; not a scan or specimen facsimile.
scientific_scope.zh: 属级化石形态规划，依据已注明名称的参考材料；并非扫描件或标本复制品。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is tall tight helicoid shell with rows of rounded nodes on descending whorls; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以高紧螺塔壳，各下降壳圈带圆瘤列为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish tall tight helicoid shell with rows of rounded nodes on descending whorls in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以高紧螺塔壳，各下降壳圈带圆瘤列搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: The source supports the named form; coloration, posture, soft tissues and fine proportions are not all established.
reference_notes: The era is a representative planning interval, not a full stratigraphic range or a coexistence claim. Verify the selected species, locality and specimen before a place-specific scene.

sources.title: 2.3 Ammonoidea - Digital Atlas of Ancient Life
sources.supports: Group anatomy, fossil context, and named specimens actually described on this page; does not verify every proposed genus.
